🫏 New post ready 📚 List · family · 8 slides “what grandma taught you without ever making it a lesson” 📝 Slides
1. what grandma taught you without ever making it a lesson 2. keeping the tin of biscuits on the low shelf, so small hands never had to stretch or ask. 3. setting four plates at the oilcloth table for three people, in case someone dropped in at one. 4. washing out empty jam jars at the sink, until every pantry shelf was full of buttons and seeds. 5. sitting on the green bench doing absolutely nothing at three o'clock, and calling it a full afternoon. 6. pressing a folded ten-pound note into your palm at the door, so you had bus money for the way back. 7. standing by the wooden gate in the rain, waving until your car reached the main road. 8. save this for a quiet Sunday, to remember the house that made you feel safe.
✍️ Caption
she never gave speeches about taking it easy, she just kept the kettle hot and left the back door unlocked. you catch yourself doing the exact same things years later and realise where you picked them up. save this for a slow morning when you miss grandma. #grandma #grandparents #grandmashouse
